description: Permanently revoke a workspace API token and disable workspace-level operations. This action cannot be undone; existing individual contract and monitor tokens are not revoked. Example: invoke workspace_revoke with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

workspaceToken.description: Secret API token for the workspace; keep it private.

name: workspace_revoke
